**Stop tuning the list’s edge on these cases, and retain A2 only as an unaccepted candidate for a fresh comparison.** A3 is negative by its fixed rule. The traces expose flaws in two of its checks, but they do not turn that result—or A2’s earlier negative result—into a pass.

The acquisition output illustrates the measurement problem: A3 lists the same termination text in two sends, while the classer assigns it different kinds. The raw outputs also support the concern on the guarantee question: A3 lists withdrawal in all three sends, and its written “Ruled out” decision names withdrawal. Whether that is an improperly repeated outcome remains a reader disagreement, because the choice shown to the judge also carries the broader appended condition. It is evidence consistent with the new sentence, not proof that the sentence caused it. [A3 result](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/RESULT-A3.md>), [stored answers](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/poc/data/clean-unlisted-probe-a3-2026-11-16/changed/send-2/outcomes.jsonl>)

A2 is the better candidate to examine because it avoids A3’s additional edge rule and showed no L failures on the selected motivating sends in the latest comparison. Its own probe was nevertheless **negative under both countings**, including a missed recovery condition under the strict counting; its added list content is visible to the product reader, so H should be reported even though H is not one of Alex’s six lines. [A2 result](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/RESULT-A2.md>)

I would not call the proposed 38 topics *held out* yet. Being absent from the three A-series probes does not establish that their matters, articles or prior readings were unseen during development. Nor should Alex’s 44 be added to another tuning comparison: D426 says the step is not changed further on those theses and no fifth Stage A is sent. [D426](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:4721>)

The next step is **one $0 design and provenance check for a fresh controlled A2 comparison**: identify topics and underlying matters not used to develop these changes, specify the frozen-control comparison and the unchanged six-line reading, and size reader work and cost. Its falsifier should include **no improvement in omitted parts, unjustified refusals or a reproducible regression elsewhere**; the decision rule must account for the observed control variation without presenting scaled lines as Alex’s original 44-topic gate. Bring that design back before sending. D391 supports stopping further tuning on the current set; it also asks that the expected effect on the reader or final judgement be stated. [D391](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:4221>), [D400](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:4376>)

CONSENSUS: no, because A2 remains a negative probe, and neither the independence of the proposed 38 topics nor use of Alex’s 44 as a further tuning set is established.
